entities.description: A close-up view of a white flagpole with a gold finial at the top, partially obscured by a white, textured object in the foreground. A blue flag is visible in the background, attached to the pole.

A marble statue of a young man with curly hair wearing a laurel wreath, draped in a toga with a brooch, holding a scroll in his right hand, standing against a clear blue sky with a flag in the background.

clothing.details: draped over left shoulder, fastened with a brooch at the chest

attributes.pose: standing, right arm extended holding scroll, left arm relaxed at side
attributes.expression: serene, looking slightly to the right
